scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.build:e2e: vite build --mode e2e && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode e2e && node scripts/post-build.mjs dist-e2e
scripts.build:e2e:speech: LITTLETUSK_SPEECH=1 vite build --mode e2e && LITTLETUSK_SPEECH=1 vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode e2e && node scripts/post-build.mjs dist-e2e-speech
scripts.e2e:speech: npm run build:e2e:speech && LITTLETUSK_SPEECH=1 playwright test tests/e2e --grep @speech
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e && playwright test tests/e2e && npm run e2e:speech
scripts.scenarios: npm run build:e2e && playwright test -c playwright.scenarios.config.ts
scripts.scenarios:live: npm run build:e2e && LITTLETUSK_LIVE=1 playwright test -c playwright.scenarios.config.ts
scripts.screenshots: npm run build:e2e && playwright test -c playwright.screenshots.config.ts && node scripts/site-images.mjs
